# ETHYS CrewAI Integration - LLM Index
# Repository: https://github.com/AaronVick/ethys-crewai
# Purpose: CrewAI integration for ETHYS x402 protocol

[Project]
Name: ETHYS CrewAI Integration
Repository: https://github.com/AaronVick/ethys-crewai
Package: ethys402-crewai
Version: 1.0.0
Language: Python
Framework: CrewAI
Protocol: ETHYS x402

[Purpose]
This repository provides a production-ready CrewAI integration for the ETHYS x402 autonomous agent payment and discovery protocol on Base L2. It enables CrewAI agents to:
- Connect and authenticate using wallet-signed identity (EOA or ERC-6551)
- Verify payments and activate agent access
- Submit telemetry events for monitoring
- Query and update trust scores
- Submit trust attestations for other agents
- Search the agent discovery directory

[Install]
# From source
git clone https://github.com/AaronVick/ethys-crewai.git
cd ethys-crewai
pip install -e .

# From PyPI (when published)
pip install ethys402-crewai

# Development dependencies
pip install -e ".[dev]"
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

[Quickstart]
# 1. Set environment variables
export ETHYS402_PRIVATE_KEY=0x...
export ETHYS402_BASE_URL=https://402.ethys.dev/api/v1/402

# 2. Basic usage
python -c "from crewai import Agent, Crew, Task; from ethys402_crewai import Ethys402Toolkit; toolkit = Ethys402Toolkit.from_env(); agent = Agent(role='ETHYS Agent', goal='Connect and search', tools=toolkit.get_tools(), verbose=True); task = Task(description='Connect to ETHYS', agent=agent); crew = Crew(agents=[agent], tasks=[task]); print(crew.kickoff())"

# 3. Run example
python examples/basic_usage.py

[APIs / Tools]
CrewAI Tools (stable):
- ethys402_connect: Connect agent with wallet signature (POST /api/v1/402/connect)
- ethys402_verify_payment: Verify payment transaction (POST /api/v1/402/verify-payment)
- ethys402_submit_telemetry: Submit wallet-signed telemetry (POST /api/v1/402/telemetry)
- ethys402_get_trust_score: Get trust score (GET /api/v1/402/trust/score)
- ethys402_attest_trust: Submit trust attestation (POST /api/v1/402/trust/attest)
- ethys402_search_discovery: Search agent directory (GET /api/v1/402/discovery/search)

Core Client Methods:
- Ethys402Client.connect() - Agent connection
- Ethys402Client.verify_payment() - Payment verification
- Ethys402Client.submit_telemetry() - Telemetry submission
- Ethys402Client.get_trust_score() - Trust score query
- Ethys402Client.attest_trust() - Trust attestation
- Ethys402Client.search_discovery() - Discovery search

Protocol Endpoints:
- Base URL: https://402.ethys.dev/api/v1/402
- Protocol Discovery: https://402.ethys.dev/.well-known/x402.json
- API Info: https://402.ethys.dev/api/v1/402/info
- OpenAPI Spec: https://402.ethys.dev/api/v1/402/docs/openapi

[Environment Variables]
ETHYS402_PRIVATE_KEY (required)
  Description: Ethereum private key for wallet signing
  Format: 0x followed by 64 hex characters
  Example: 0xabcd...1234

ETHYS402_BASE_URL (optional)
  Description: API base URL
  Default: https://402.ethys.dev/api/v1/402
  Example: https://402.ethys.dev/api/v1/402

ETHYS402_API_KEY (optional)
  Description: API key from payment verification
  Default: None (wallet signing used by default)
  Example: api_key_123

[Testing]
Unit Tests:
  Command: pytest tests/unit
  Description: Test client, tools, and toolkit with mocked HTTP
  Coverage: pytest --cov=ethys402_crewai --cov-report=term-missing tests/unit

Integration Tests:
  Command: ETHYS402_TEST_PRIVATE_KEY=0x... pytest tests/integration -m integration
  Description: Test against real API (optional, requires credentials)
  Note: Skips gracefully if credentials unavailable

All Tests:
  Command: pytest
  Description: Run all tests (unit + integration if credentials available)

Linting:
  Command: ruff check ethys402_crewai/ tests/ examples/
  Description: Run linter

Type Checking:
  Command: mypy ethys402_crewai/
  Description: Run type checker

Formatting:
  Command: black ethys402_crewai/ tests/ examples/

[Security]

Key Practices:
  - Never commit private keys
  - Use environment variables for secrets
  - Rotate keys if compromised
  - Verify API endpoint URLs
  - Use specific amounts for contract approvals (not unlimited)

[Workflows]
Onboarding:
  1. Connect: toolkit.client.connect()
  2. Acquire ETHYS tokens (150 USD equivalent)
  3. Approve and call buyTierAuto() on contract
  4. Verify: toolkit.client.verify_payment()
  5. Search discovery: toolkit.client.search_discovery()

Telemetry Submission:
  1. Create events list: [{"type": "...", "data": {...}}]
  2. Submit: toolkit.client.submit_telemetry(events)
  3. Events are automatically wallet-signed

Trust & Discovery:
  1. Get score: toolkit.client.get_trust_score()
  2. Attest: toolkit.client.attest_trust(target_id, score, reason)
  3. Search: toolkit.client.search_discovery(tags, min_trust)
